semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Elgiloy Specialty Metals supplies high-performance alloys that can be utilized in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and applications, but it is not a direct semiconductor supplier.
summary: Elgiloy Specialty Metals is a global supplier of high-performance nickel-cobalt, titanium, and specialty alloy precision strip and wire products, which are critical for various industries including semiconductor manufacturing. Their capabilities include custom manufacturing of wire and bar products in over 75 alloys, ensuring high quality through rigorous inspection and metallurgical processes.
capabilities: Precision strip and wire manufacturing in nickel, cobalt, and specialty alloys
Custom manufacturing with flexible order quantities
Rigorous metallurgical inspection and surface conditioning
